page.title: Squads
page.empty_no_squads: No squads yet. Create one to get started.

archive_dialog.title: Archive this squad?
archive_dialog.description: "{{name}}" will be archived. Issues currently assigned to this squad will be transferred to its leader. This can't be undone — create a new squad if you need the routing back.

add_member_dialog.title: Add Member
add_member_dialog.description: Add a workspace member or agent to this squad.

discard_changes_dialog.title: Discard unsaved changes?
discard_changes_dialog.description: You have unsaved changes on this tab. Switching tabs will discard them.

visual_tab.workflow_description: Generated from the squad goal, leader guidance, and member responsibilities
visual_tab.drag_hint: Drag an agent to this stage
visual_tab.reset_success: Generated agent assignments and stage order restored
visual_tab.reset_failed: Failed to restore the default workflow
visual_tab.generate_description: This rereads the squad description, leader guidance, and all member responsibilities, then replaces the current stages and agent arrangement. Manual stages and drag results will be overwritten.
visual_tab.stage_dialog_description: Define the responsibility of this stage in the collaboration workflow.
visual_tab.stage_description_placeholder: Describe the goal, inputs, and expected result of this stage
visual_tab.delete_stage_description: “{{name}}” will be removed from the workflow. Manual assignments in this stage will be cleared; the agents will not be deleted.
visual_tab.fallback_reason: No clear stage was identified; placed under collaboration support

requirements.title: Requirements
requirements.description: Clarify goals, scope, constraints, and acceptance criteria

knowledge.title: Standards and knowledge
knowledge.description: Gather standards, domain knowledge, and existing context

research.title: System research
research.description: Inspect the current system, code, and dependencies

design.title: Solution design
design.description: Define the technical approach, decisions, and task breakdown

implementation.title: Implementation
implementation.description: Implement the solution, configuration, and essential checks

review.title: Code review
review.description: Review correctness, completeness, risk, and maintainability

test.title: Test and fix
test.description: Validate behavior, fix defects, and run regression checks

delivery.title: Test handoff and delivery
delivery.description: Prepare deliverables, hand off for testing, release, and report results

support.title: Collaboration support
support.description: Handle specialist work outside the standard delivery stages

instructions_tab.description: Squad instructions are injected into the leader agent's prompt whenever it works on an issue assigned to this squad. Use them to give the leader squad-wide guidance, working agreements, or context the leader should follow on every task.
